net-ionic-steps.alt: Three stacked boxes. Molecular equation: Pb(NO₃)₂(aq) + 2KI(aq) → PbI₂(s) + 2KNO₃(aq). Complete ionic equation: Pb²⁺(aq) + 2NO₃⁻(aq) + 2K⁺(aq) + 2I⁻(aq) → PbI₂(s) + 2K⁺(aq) + 2NO₃⁻(aq), with the potassium and nitrate ions crossed out on both sides as spectators. Net ionic equation: Pb²⁺(aq) + 2I⁻(aq) → PbI₂(s). Atoms and charge balance.
